div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/shielding-condition-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: No structural or suit shielding beyond the ambient environment (e.g., open-space exposure)
Suit fabric or thin structure only, roughly below 1 g/cm2 areal density (e.g., lunar surface EVA)
Nominal vehicle or habitat structure, roughly 5-20 g/cm2 areal density (e.g., Orion crew module, Gateway HALO)
Augmented shielding such as water walls, polyethylene, or regolith cover
Crew located in a dedicated solar particle event storm shelter configuration

description.value: Qualitative radiation shielding condition of the crew at the time of a radiation exposure measurement
